description: Seed evaluation set. Questions are scoped to a handful of well-known papers that should be ingested before running eval, so retrieval has something real to find. Expand this over time as the feedback loop queues up disagreements.

qa_pairs.question: What mechanism does the Transformer architecture use instead of recurrence?
What is the main pretraining objective used by BERT?
How does GPT-3 approach few-shot learning?

citation_integrity_cases.description: Known supported case, used to check the integrity engine does not over-flag correct citations.
citation_integrity_cases.claim: Vaswani et al. proposed the Transformer architecture based entirely on attention mechanisms, without recurrence or convolution.

note: This seed set is intentionally small. The point of the eval harness is the pipeline (metrics, CI gating, dashboard trend), not an exhaustive benchmark. Grow qa_pairs and citation_integrity_cases as real usage and feedback come in.
